versions.changelog:
- Initial release of "monitoring-google-news-coverage-for-brand" skill.
- Monitors Google News for brand-related coverage using apidojo's Google Search scraper on Apify.
- Returns article title, publication, date, URL, and sentiment for each result.
- Designed for PR agencies, communications teams, and brand managers to track press mentions and sentiment.
- Supports comprehensive output breakdowns (editorial, press release, sentiment, PR flags) and several usage methods (CLI, MCP, REST API).
- Includes input parameters for search terms, country, max results, and customization options.
